title: Emitted-site progress condition
statement: Fix a Boolean parameter $\ell$, natural numbers $n,i,B$, a Boolean-valued function $o$ on five indices and bit strings, a list $S$ of Boolean values, a configuration $a$, and a predicate $P$ on configurations. The condition $\mathrm{Em}(k,S,a,P)$ requires both of the following: whenever $k\le i<k+|S|$, the walk machine halts from $a$ on input $\langle 1^n,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle$ with outcome $\ell\lor S[i-k]$ (using false if that list position is out of range), under the register bound $B$; and whenever $k+|S|\le i$, there is a configuration satisfying $P$ that is reachable from $a$ on that input under the same register bound.
hypotheses_covered: function assigning a Boolean outcome to each of five indices and each bit string
